column5: GROUP: package-manager (034): | - `PM/resolution/graph/accepted.rs:60-66`: catalog search takes the first match before checking purpose, so "two catalog entries differing only by purpose would see only the first".

GROUP: package-manager (034): | - `PM/resolution/graph/mod.rs:60-66` and `PM/resolution/source/custody.rs:101`: lineage check is `debug_assert!` only; in release "a key/resolution pair with mismatched lineage" gets through if a caller passes unvalidated parts.
GROUP: package-manager (034): | - `PM/resolution/graph/subject/catalog.rs:31-35`: `zip` silently drops extra entries if lengths differ; "I infer it matches".

GROUP: package-manager (034): | - `PM/review/candidate/review_cache.rs:197-200`: the trailer is an unkeyed SHA-256; "a hand-built record with a correct trailer and matching lineage/resolution digests would be accepted", and the build handoff is not recomputed; open for the handoff and policy content.

GROUP: package-manager (034): | - Panics, not accepts, also classed open: `PM/review/candidate/error.rs:184` (byte slice of a name), `PM/review/compare/assembly.rs:73-75` (slice indexing if lock occurrences are misaligned).

GROUP: resolver-execution (034): | - `RX/resolver_execution/path_custody.rs:77`: when a root cannot be canonicalized only the lexical test runs; "an executable whose canonical path lies under a root that cannot be canonicalized at open time" passes. Not traced to callers.

GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/authority.rs:111`: "a new core service not listed in the table is reviewed as ordinary"; also `TimeHostService` is not in the aggregate-binding list.
GROUP: review-evidence (034, 035, 036): | - `RE/capture/api/data/evidence.rs:154-155,181-182`: a context or symbol set with a missing span that is not about a data symbol is skipped.
